The photo shows a wrap cut in half, a glass of orange juice, a toasted sandwich cut in half, and six pieces of sushi. I estimated each item from its apparent size and typical ingredients.

| Item | Estimate | kcal |
|---|---|---|
| Wrap (tortilla, cheese, carrot, lettuce) | Whole wrap | 350 |
| Orange juice | About 200 ml | 90 |
| Toasted sandwich (seeded bread, filling uncertain) | Whole sandwich | 250 |
| Sushi | 6 pieces at about 40 kcal each | 240 |

The total served is about 930 kcal.

The photo is taken before eating, so I can't see what will be left over. I assumed a small amount, about 5%, or roughly 30 kcal. That leaves about 900 kcal eaten.

For the macronutrients, I assumed a typical split for these foods (about 15% protein, 55% carbohydrate, 30% fat by energy):
- Protein: about 30 g
- Carbohydrate: about 120 g
- Fat: about 30 g
